Minimum word count (wv_min_count): 30 — words appearing fewer than 30 times are excluded from the vocabulary
Window size (wv_window_size): 5 — the context window considers 5 words on each side
Training algorithm (wv_training_algorithm): 0 — typically indicates CBOW (Continuous Bag of Words) in Word2Vec implementations
Top N words per topic (bert_top_n_words): 30 — each topic is represented by its 30 most representative terms
